dct_title_s: Caribbean Sea, Venezuela, Cabo Codera to Cabo Tres Puntas, including Isla la Tortuga to Islas los Testigos (Raster Image)
dct_description_sm: Prepared and published by the Defense Mapping Agency Hydrographic/Topographic Center. Depths shown by isolines and soundings. Relief shown by contours and spot heights. "From HYCOOP surveys and Venezuelan charts to 1991." "Copyright restrictions of the country of origin continue to exist." "Copyright 1993 by the United States government ; no copyright claimed under Title 17 U.S.C." "Soundings in meters." Includes source diagram and index to next larger scale charts. Map no.24430.
This map is part of a collection of scanned and georeferenced nautical charts produced by the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA).
